high_level_description: The image shows three women standing side by side against a plain white background. The woman on the left is wearing a traditional Indian saree with a pink blouse and gold and silver patterns. She has long, wavy hair and is accessorized with large green earrings and bangles on her wrists. The woman in the middle is dressed in a white off-the-shoulder gown with a deep neckline, adorned with a statement necklace featuring a large red gemstone. Her hair is styled in an updo. The woman on the right is wearing a black sleeveless dress and a multi-strand necklace.
